defect: With a read share of one command, the slot a device terminal frees goes to a GET admitted in the same owner turn, so a read that already waits is never submitted while the demand lasts.

property.text: Every waiting read submits within read_ops calls with room in slot order from the cursor, stopping at the first submit refused as full.

evidence.steps: No fault. A volume whose read share is one command: one read holds the command at the device and a second read waits under its kept grant. The held read's terminal and a GET of the same key from the other client reach the owner before one Owner::poll turn, which applies the terminal in poll_terminals and admits the GET in receive_batch, before the volume's tick; the GET's first submit takes the freed command, and while the demand repeats the waiting read gets none until its deadline. The history ss2-peer-read-waits-for-one-command (net/world_tests/histories/saturated_shares.rs) runs these steps over Geometry::OneReadCommand; the record's own trigger used four keys of one client.
evidence.sweep: One sweep of cluster-swarm, cluster-pressure and upload on the unfixed build: root bsw-ct1-2101-probe-cluster-424e30371 under the campaign root, archive of head 424e30371 (build a22460533b6e3c6ed9968422d2fd549011e75c64e8393cc0301ac16c368bd18b, dirty false), campaign bsw-ct1-2101-probe-cluster-424e30371, 28 workers for 60 s; runs 0..6192 of cluster-swarm, 0..14407 of cluster-pressure and 0..158022 of upload, each run at its own root; suspects 0, new_suspects 0, replays 27, 1700 control runs caught and none missed, no alarm. cluster-swarm and cluster-pressure build their storage with storage_shaped_as over the fixture geometry (net/world_tests/cluster.rs), and upload runs UPLOAD_PLAN, which keeps QUIET's Geometry::Fixture, through Geometry::storage (net/world_tests.rs); both storages keep a read share of three commands (sized_config in storage/owner_fixture.rs), so none of the three named profiles forms a one-command read share. This claim covers those three profiles; the sweep's history batches, which list the pins, ran no SS2 or K9 history in this sweep (each at runs 0).

catch.rule: an eligible peer's GET starved behind a saturated share

note: Cause, evidence and catch are set by the unit of #297 that writes this family's history (M1-3). Both run under `Owner::poll` in crates/kestrike/src/net/owner.rs.
